units.function: Focused CLI tests for reviewing one pipeline case, bulk review decisions and batch ingestion of dependency-linked cases from JSON files.
units.dependencyDirection: The Vitest suite registers the pipeline Commander module, uses temporary JSON files and a stubbed HTTP client, and asserts request URLs and complete JSON bodies.
units.keyDataModels: Company and case opaque IDs, pipeline key/id, case key/title, blockedByCaseKeys dependency edges, review decision/reason and expectedVersion, plus bulk item arrays.
units.lifecycle: Resolve pipeline by key; ingest a batch of dependency-linked cases; request changes on one case with optimistic version; or read a local decision batch and send it to a company-scoped bulk review endpoint.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 3/3 tests on 2026-08-19 and CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. It usefully asserts full bodies for request_changes, expectedVersion and dependency edges, but omits approve/reject alternatives, malformed files, duplicate/cyclic/missing dependencies, partial bulk failure, authorization, idempotency, review evidence and concurrent-version rejection.
units.designRationale: Enable operators and automation to load structured repeatable workflows and review many cases while preserving basic optimistic concurrency and explicit change reasons.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS FDE delivery and industry templates need configurable repeatable workflows, dependency graphs, human review queues, bulk operations and versioned decisions without hard-coding each customer's process into product code.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the dependency-key ingestion and expected-version review contract as a candidate FDE/template mechanism. Reframe a case as governed Work bound to organization, accountable human, policy/data grants, risk and evidence; bulk review must remain individually authorized and produce per-item immutable results. Do not adopt Paperclip pipeline names or schema before the owning server/data units are audited.
units.responsibilityConflict: A reason and expectedVersion improve review integrity, but the tested decision carries no reviewer identity/authority, responsibility-contract id, exact action/evidence digest or signature. Bulk review can amplify an authorization error unless every item is independently policy-checked and recorded.

2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 3 tests passed
securityFindings: Local JSON files are treated as untrusted workflow/review input, but this test does not cover file-size limits, schema validation, unknown fields, unsafe values or symlink/path behavior.
Expected version is tested only as forwarded data; server rejection, retry and prevention of stale approval are not verified.
Dependency graphs have no tested duplicate key, unknown key, self-edge, cycle, fan-out/size or topological-order constraints.
Bulk review expects an empty results response and does not verify all-or-nothing versus partial semantics, per-item errors, idempotency or durable receipts.
Authentication uses one fixed bearer token; tenant scope, reviewer authority and separation between Agent and human decisions are untested.
Review reasons are free text without tested size/content handling or evidence references.
